## Need

What task would this help a user or contributor complete?

## Proposal

Describe the smallest useful behavior, command or documentation change.

## Scope and boundaries

Would this touch runtime code, model assets, SDK setup, documentation or the hosted demo? Note any device, browser or license assumptions that still need evidence.

## Verification

How could a contributor reproduce or review the result? Include a proposed SDK-free test, browser check or documentation check where appropriate.
